system: UAV-Based Intelligent Agricultural Field Assessment & Paddy Yield Estimation System

datasets.dataset_name: Paddy Doctor: A Visual Dataset for Paddy Crop Disease and Pest Assessment
datasets.intended_use: Paddy crop health condition classification, field stress detection, and visual evidence validation.
datasets.known_limitations: Acquired by field agronomists via handheld smartphones under ambient daylight in Tamil Nadu/Southern India. Provides in-situ paddy canopy views rather than nadir orthomosaic UAV flights.

datasets.dataset_name: Agriculture-Vision: A Large Aerial Image Database for Agricultural Pattern Analysis
datasets.publisher: CVPR Workshop on Agriculture-Vision / University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
datasets.intended_use: Aerial field boundary delineation, canopy anomaly segmentation, and crop stress mapping.
datasets.known_limitations: Captured primarily over North American corn and soybean fields; requires domain fine-tuning and calibration for smallholder flooded paddy plots in Odisha.

datasets.dataset_name: Rice Image Dataset: High-Resolution Grain Morphometry
datasets.intended_use: Grain morphology verification, variety identification, and post-harvest quality assessment.
datasets.known_limitations: Individual flat grain scans under laboratory lightbox. This is strictly a grain-variety classification dataset and NOT a 3D bulk harvest heap volume dataset.

datasets.dataset_name: Odisha Agricultural Statistics & Crop Cutting Experiment (CCE) Yield Benchmarks
datasets.publisher: Directorate of Agriculture & Food Production, Government of Odisha
authors: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment, Odisha
labels_and_annotations: Calibrated rough paddy bulk density (ρ): 578.0 kg/m³ at 14% standardized moisture content
PMFBY threshold yield baseline: 1,920 kg/acre for Cuttack coastal delta
datasets.intended_use: Ground-truth calibration constants for photogrammetric volume-to-mass conversions (M = V * ρ) and official DAO certificate verification.
datasets.known_limitations: Aggregated regional statistical benchmarks derived from physical crop-cutting experiments, not continuous parcel-level photogrammetry.

heap_dataset_limitation_statement.statement: No peer-reviewed, open-access, multi-view photogrammetric dataset exists specifically for in-situ harvested rough paddy heaps piled on rural threshing yards (Khalia). AgriSentinel implements an authentic multi-view photogrammetry pipeline (feature extraction, bundle adjustment, base plane estimation, and volume integration) capable of processing overlapping drone or smartphone camera series, while providing a surveyed reference calibration baseline.
